title: The 3-part story
summary: Tell the story of a bug in three parts: beginning, problem, end.

steps.title: Beginning, problem, end
steps.body:
Every story about something that went wrong has three parts. The beginning, when everything still seemed fine. The problem, the exact moment something broke or went sideways. The end, how it got fixed or how it turned out. Skip the beginning and no one knows what you were even trying to do. Skip the problem and the story has no point. Skip the end and no one knows what happened.

The question of the week is: can a robot be your friend? Think about what a friend actually does: notices how you feel, remembers things about you, chooses to spend time with you. Use your answer to the question as the ending of your talk.

steps.title: Tell the story of a bug
steps.body: Pick a bug from your badge or your dice, something that did not work the first time you tried it. Tell it in three parts: what you were trying to do, what went wrong, and how you fixed it or what happened in the end. Practise saying it twice with a timer running.
checklist: Names the bug clearly in the beginning
Explains exactly what went wrong in the middle
Ends with how it was fixed, or what you learned

steps.title: Record it
steps.prompt: Record the 3-part story of your bug. Phone propped up, whole face in frame.
